evidence_level: Published hypothetical index history analysis; not executable option account backtest
known_history: Prior BXM/PUT/PPUT/CLL annual audit and source documents contain known outcomes. This is not untouched validation.

benchmark.meaning: Adjusted close total-return proxy from preserved Yahoo snapshot, earliest 1997-01-02. No pre-1997 matched history or historical publication-vintage claim.

dense_rule: Cut rows at 2025-12-31. Dense segment starts at first row after final >31 calendar-day gap, or first row if none. Exclude its initial calendar year; baseline is that year's last row. Require >=240 observations in every following calendar year through 2025; failing year refuses window rather than stitching.
common_rule: Baseline last row of 2013; follow all 2014-2025 rows. Require >=240 rows each year. No forward fill or interpolation. Gaps >7 calendar days reported; observed-close drawdown may understate loss.
cost_model: Continuous annual drag: value(t)=1000*index(t)/index(t0)*exp(-drag*elapsed_calendar_days/365.2425). Generic sensitivity, not actual commissions, slippage, taxes or funding. No added leverage.
benchmark_comparison: Exact date intersection, no forward fill. Both paths rebase to 1000 at first common date. Label matched subwindow separately; index drag versus zero additional SPY drag. Report dates/count/gaps. Nasdaq/Russell compares SPY as common reference, not matching underlying.
fresh_starts: First observed date of each calendar month within window; exit exactly h observations later if available. Fresh 1000 normalized at start, same calendar-day drag. No annualization. Overlapping dependent windows.
exclusions: No timing overlay, parameter search, outcome-driven selection, index rule changes, synthetic option prices, invented fills or claimed $1000 contract feasibility. Retain all 25 indices and 150 scenarios/refusals. No broker promotion.
validation: Artificial tests for known arithmetic/date gaps/missing data; separate Decimal checker re-reads original CSVs and reconstructs annual/CAGR/drawdown/fresh-start metrics without calling the analysis module; input hashes; public outputs derived only.
